comparisons.name: base_order_dispatch
comparisons.requirement: The leftmost provider wins, including when provider values differ.

comparisons.name: base_order_super_callback
comparisons.requirement: The cooperative sink receives a, b exactly once in that order.

comparisons.name: base_order_three_super_callback
comparisons.requirement: Three cooperative callbacks occur exactly once in a, b, c order.

comparisons.name: base_order_commuting_control
comparisons.requirement: Both labels are required; their insertion order is not contractual.

comparisons.name: base_order_explicit_call_control
comparisons.requirement: Explicit delegation promises a, b order independently of the base list.

comparisons.name: base_order_mro_risk
comparisons.requirement: Child(B, A) is constructible; reversing dependent bases invalidates C3 MRO.
